refs.how_to_use: In Leonardo (Nano Banana 2), attach faces/couple_anchor.jpg as an Image Reference for two-person shots; use hero_face / heroine_face for solo shots. Prompt: 'Using the woman/man/couple from the reference image, keep exact same face and identity...'

look.heroine: extremely attractive Indian woman, mid-20s, flawless fair North-Indian complexion, big expressive dark eyes, sharp cheekbones, soft full nude-rose lips, long dark wet-tousled hair, natural glam makeup, dark floral kurta with a thin pendant necklace
look.hero: ruggedly handsome Indian man, mid-20s, strong sharp jawline, light stubble, thick wet dark hair pushed back, fair skin, fit athletic frame, dark navy shirt
look.world: warm monsoon rain at night on a glowing city street; warm amber street-lamp rim light against deep teal-blue night; dreamy bokeh of city lights and falling rain; 85mm f/1.4 shallow DOF; moody filmic grade; lifelike skin with visible pores; subtle 35mm film grain; romantic Bollywood cinema aesthetic

couple walking hand-in-hand, wide — chorus payoff

motion_recipe: Leonardo Video → Hailuo 2.3 → Start frame = a library still (Select Media > Your Generations) → 9:16, 6s → prompt 'Cinematic subtle motion: <what moves>, keep face(s) exactly the same, no morphing, no warping'. 98 tokens/clip. Faces hold cleanly.
compliance: original AI couple; no celebrity likeness; fair & unmistakably Indian; synthetic-media disclosure ON at upload
